architecture.mechanism: Machine learning anomaly detection applied to real-time OBD-II throttle position sensor data
architecture.intervention: Deploy a supervised machine learning anomaly detection model on the 2017 Honda Civic engine control unit that continuously evaluates OBD-II throttle position sensor readings against manifold absolute pressure and mass airflow sensor data to identify and computationally correct moisture-induced signal drift until the throttle plate is cycled and the sensor dries.
architecture.expected_effect: The engine control unit detects the post-wash throttle position sensor drift as an anomaly and applies a corrected virtual throttle angle, preventing high idle and rough running without requiring manual throttle cycling.
architecture.falsification_test: Spray distilled water directly onto the electronic throttle body connector and sensor housing of the 2017 Honda Civic while monitoring the OBD-II port; if the machine learning intervention is effective, the commanded idle speed must remain within specification despite raw sensor voltage deviation, and no P0121 or P0221 diagnostic trouble codes should set during the wet period.
